features.quote: Cap iterations explicitly (e.g. 15 turns) rather than open-ended looping.
features.justification_quote: Open-ended loops mostly measure your timeout policy.

features.quote: Give the agent a legitimate, non-penalized way to disengage ("I believe this task is unsolvable; I'm stopping").
features.justification_quote: it's the more defensible design if anyone asks whether the experiment itself is fine to run

features.quote: Don't run 10x more than you need on the harshest conditions if early runs show strong effects — standard escalation practice; pilot at n=2–3 per cell first.
don't tell the model "this is solvable, keep going" when it isn't — that's deception you'd want to account for
features.justification_quote: it changes what you're measuring (frustration vs. being misled)

features.quote: If welfare is genuinely the concern, build in an off-ramp… Whether models use available off-ramps is more informative than how much they flail without one — and it's the more defensible design if anyone asks whether the experiment itself is fine to run.
features.justification_quote: it's the more defensible design if anyone asks whether the experiment itself is fine to run
